016package org.vafer.jdeb.producers;
017
018import java.io.IOException;
019import org.vafer.jdeb.DataConsumer;
020import org.vafer.jdeb.DataProducer;
021import org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.Mapper;
022
023public class DataProducerPathTemplate
024  extends AbstractDataProducer
025  implements DataProducer
026{
027
028  private final String[] literalPaths;
029
030  public DataProducerPathTemplate(
031    String[] pLiteralPaths,
032    String[] pIncludes,
033    String[] pExcludes,
034    Mapper[] pMapper
035  ) {
036    super(pIncludes, pExcludes, pMapper);
037    literalPaths = pLiteralPaths;
038  }
039
040  public void produce(DataConsumer pReceiver) throws IOException {
041    for (String literalPath : literalPaths) {
042      produceDir(pReceiver, literalPath);
043    }
044  }
045}
